_note: Where each generated piece sits on a character's portrait head.
Every piece is its own Tripo run, normalised to about 1 unit on its longest axis,
sitting z 0..height in its own file - so nothing lines up until it is scaled and
moved onto the head here. The portrait head measures 0.515 wide, 0.613 deep and
1.0 tall, widest at 70% of its height, with the face pointing +Z in Godot.
offset is in the head's own space, Y-up, after scaling. These are a placement to
nudge by eye, not a measurement to defend.
in_frame false keeps a piece out of the portrait framing. The hat's plume is part
of the hat mesh, so the hat is framed and the plume is allowed to run off the top.
